system.description: You surrender to a Lord Beyond, who remakes your form and grants a new power, at the cost of two Negative Social Traits per investiture taken (multiple purchases stack both benefits and Negative Traits). Sample investitures: Ignore the Searing Flames (complete immunity to fire and its fear, but not Essence of the Netherworld); Demonic Form (bat-like wings granting flight as the Gargoyle power, plus two additional levels of lethal unarmed damage); Blood Hive (three vomitable insect swarms, each absorbing three levels of lethal damage, draining one Blood Trait per turn from a victim and carrying up to five back to you); Tentacled Grasp (three bonus Traits on grappling/climbing challenges and one additional unpenalized attack per turn).
